title: Cosmos DB SDK and Developer Patterns
description: Use the Cosmos DB .NET SDK to create, read, update, and delete items with async patterns and bulk operations.

data.text: The Azure Cosmos DB .NET SDK gives you full control over CRUD operations, bulk imports, change feed processing, and transactional batch writes. The modern SDK (v4+) uses async methods throughout and provides typed options for throughput, consistency, and retry behavior.

The SDK follows a top-down client model: `CosmosClient` connects to the account, `DatabaseClient` scopes to a database, and `ContainerClient` scopes to a container. This hierarchy mirrors the Azure resource model and keeps your code clean.

data.text: Bulk mode maximizes throughput by batching operations across partitions and parallelizing them. Enable it on the client options and the SDK handles the rest — no manual batching required.

data.title: Reuse CosmosClient
data.text: CosmosClient is thread-safe and designed to be reused for the lifetime of your application. Do not create a new client per request — this exhausts sockets and connections.

data.title: Exercise: Build a CRUD Wrapper
data.description: Write a small service class that encapsulates common Cosmos DB operations.
steps: Create a ProductService class with methods: CreateAsync, GetAsync, UpdateAsync, DeleteAsync.
Accept a ContainerClient in the constructor (dependency injection style).
Use async/await throughout and return strongly typed Product objects.
Add a BulkCreateAsync method that inserts multiple products using Task.WhenAll.
Write unit tests that mock the ContainerClient to verify behavior.
data.expectedOutcome: A reusable, testable service class for Cosmos DB CRUD operations.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use CosmosClient as a singleton throughout your application.
Async methods keep your app responsive under concurrent load.
Bulk mode dramatically improves throughput for batch operations.
The SDK handles retries, routing, and partitioning automatically.
data.takeaway: The .NET SDK provides a clean, performant way to work with Cosmos DB from any .NET application.
